name: Grilled Chicken Satay over Rice Noodles with Cucumber & Radish Salad
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice one lime into a small bowl (reserve remaining lime for later use).
Peel and mince ginger; add to the bowl with the lime juice along with peanut butter, fish sauce, water, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the satay sauce.

Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; place in a medium bowl. Pour half of the satay sauce over the chicken, stir to coat, and set aside. (Set remaining sauce aside for serving.)
Once the water in the pot is boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Thread chicken onto skewers and place on a plate; alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add the skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, juice remaining lime into another medium bowl. Add oil, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice radishes into thin rounds; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems, roughly chop the leaves, and add to the bowl with the veggies. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide rice noodles, salad, and chicken skewers between plates or bowls; drizzle reserved satay sauce over the chicken. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
